errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the label "Обучение за основните елементи на пасивната къща" (Training on the basic elements of a passive house) to the 23% slice. According to the legend and figure, this label corresponds to the 16% slice. The 23% slice corresponds to "Обучение за проектиране на Пасивна къща" (Training on passive house design).
